explanation: He abdicated in 1912 but lived on in the Forbidden City until 1924. Freed from prison in 1959, he worked for a time as a gardener in Beijing.

claims.text: Puyi was the last emperor of China.
Puyi became emperor in 1908, aged two.
Guangxu was Puyi's predecessor, who died in 1908, and Kangxi and Qianlong were Qing emperors of the 1600s and 1700s.
Puyi abdicated in 1912 and was allowed to live in the Forbidden City until 1924.
Puyi was released from prison in 1959 and then worked as a gardener at a botanical garden in Beijing.
